description: Map encounter zone mapping derived from map header table. Each map has a zone_id field (u32 at offset 28) that controls encounter behavior. The zone_id is used by the battle system to determine which encounter table to use when the player is on that map.

entry_format.description: 32-byte map header entries. Zone ID is the last field (offset 28).

fields.name: extra_data_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to extra data (0 if none)

fields.name: collision_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to collision data (0 if none)

fields.name: zone_id
fields.description: Encounter zone ID (1-7, 258 for special maps)

unique_handlers.description: Standard handler - loads audio cmd from struct[0x770]
Zone map handler - no direct audio
Battle handler - loads audio cmd from struct[0x770]
Alt battle handler - no direct audio dispatcher call

verification_method: Static analysis of map header table at 0x53D910. Zone ID field at offset 28 confirmed by examining all 47 map entries. Values 1-7 plus 258 (0x0102) observed. Cross-referenced with map event handler table at 0x53EB08 showing 6 unique handlers that reference zone data. Battle event handler table at 0x53E6D8 shows 3 unique handlers.
discovered_by: Map header table structure analysis + event handler disasm
notes: Zone ID 258 (0x0102) appears on maps 7 and 8 which have the 0x0102 flag in the map header. These maps share identical pointers to maps 9-12 (zone 3). The zone_id likely indexes into a separate encounter probability table at runtime. The encounter threshold check pattern (CMP + BCC) was not found via static analysis, suggesting the encounter rate is computed dynamically per-zone at runtime.
